title: Where the Coverage-Day Count Starts on a Northgate Protect Accident Plan Refund
content:
On a Northgate Protect Accident-tier plan, where the counting of coverage days starts depends on how the plan was bought, as the plan record shows:

- **Plan bought after its item was fulfilled:** the coverage days start on the day after the waiting period ends, that is the coverage start date plus the tier's waiting period days (30 days on the Accident tiers).
- **Plan bought on or before its item was fulfilled, whose coverage started more than 7 days after the plan purchase date:** the coverage days start on the plan purchase date.
- **Any other plan:** the coverage days start on the coverage start date.

The coverage days so counted run through the day before the coverage end date, and the unused coverage days are never more than the coverage days so counted.

## Judgement table

| Bought after fulfilment | Days from plan purchase date to coverage start date | Count starts on |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | Coverage start date plus 30 days |
| No | 8 or more | Plan purchase date |
| No | 0 to 7 | Coverage start date |

## Cases on hypothetical dates

- Bought after delivery; coverage start date 10 June: the count starts on 10 July.
- Bought on 1 June with the order; the item delivered on 15 June, 14 days later: the count starts on 1 June.
- Bought on 1 June; delivered on 8 June, 7 days later, not more than 7: the count starts on 8 June. Delivered on 9 June, 8 days later: the count starts on 1 June.
